values: A flow reduction for equilibrium uniqueness in rank-one bimatrix games. Accepted scope: Exactly-one mixed Nash equilibrium pair is coNP-complete for variable-dimension explicit rational rank(A+B)=1 games with degeneracy allowed; known strict default plus second equilibrium iff PARTITION yes. Limits: No gap asserted under these quantifiers; nondegenerate-promise, strong hardness, fixed dimensions and payoff-uniqueness variants excluded. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness remain unestablished.
